evidence: Modifies `ci/test/03_test_script.sh` to add several `src/` files to `IWYU_SRC_FILES` so that IWYU warnings in them are enforced as fatal errors in CI.
rationale: Expanding IWYU enforcement in CI to cover additional files is routine code cleanup. While the author notes it is needed for follow-up work in #36808, tightening include checks has marginal impact on build reliability or release integrity.
